As a first-in-class TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor, LISRAYA provides broad clinical benefits, including improved muscle strength, skin clearance, enhanced physical function, and reduced heavy steroid use.
Phase 3 VALOR Trial Highlights Steroid Reduction
Approval stems from the Phase 3 VALOR study, the largest clinical trial completed in dermatomyositis.
Participants receiving LISRAYA showed statistically meaningful gains on the myositis Total Improvement Score by Week 4 and maintained progress through 52 weeks.
By study completion, 55% of LISRAYA patients achieved moderate or better disease improvement while requiring minimal to no steroids, compared with 30% of placebo participants.

Additionally, among patients using high-dose oral corticosteroids at baseline, 62% on LISRAYA reduced their dosage to minimal levels, compared with 38% on placebo. Furthermore, 45% of LISRAYA patients eliminated steroid usage, compared to 29% in the placebo arm.
Patient-Reported Outcomes Confirm Daily Functional Benefits
In addition to objective measures of muscle strength and skin symptoms, patients taking LISRAYA reported over fourfold greater improvement in overall disease activity than placebo recipients.
LISRAYA patients also registered meaningful gains in daily functional tasks such as climbing stairs and running errands, whereas placebo patients suffered functional decline.
